# Corpus index

The front door for the `presentation-sites` monorepo. How this corpus works and
the retrieval budget: [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md). How work routes:
[routing.md](routing.md). Chronological changes: [log.md](log.md).

New here? Read [wiki/overview.md](wiki/overview.md), then
[wiki/status.md](wiki/status.md).

## Wiki

<!-- CATALOG:START — generated by lint.sh --index; do not hand-edit -->
- [architecture](wiki/architecture.md) — How a site in this repo is put together — the shared Astro/Tailwind shape, the mock-vs-real image pipeline, the gitignored real-data split, and where deploy lives.
- [decisions](wiki/decisions.md) — Locked structural choices for this monorepo — self-contained sites, deploy living elsewhere, env-driven base paths, the mock/real image split, and gitignored business data. Do not relitigate without a log entry.

- [status](wiki/status.md) — Dated snapshot of where each site stands and what this root corpus does versus the per-site docs. The living dashboard — start here after a break.
